string.text: : reachable, but the preprocessing response format is invalid:
Postprocessing test used its token budget on reasoning only; retrying with reasoning disabled: completion_tokens=
Postprocessing test succeeded after disabling reasoning: control_mode=
I am an adventurer. Hello! (Play a cheerful child named Habo and give a warm reply of roughly 20 words.)
You are an action-tag emitter. Output only tags.
You are a test echo assistant. Output only one short reply.
Please reply: Event and rebellion endpoint connected

Use a stable prefix and append-only transcript for free conversation and scene shout. Only accepted replies enter the cache. Provider cache hits and prices remain provider-dependent. Applies to the next request.

Counts the complete cached request, including system, references and current input. Rebuilds a complete snapshot before this limit; an oversized snapshot uses the original request subject to the final context budget. This is a cache-storage limit, not the model token limit. Default: 150000.
Reuse within the same runtime, channel and scene or native conversation identity. Expired sessions restart with a complete snapshot. No Tick scanning or save data. Default: 10 minutes.
Use recent original speech, intraday segment summaries and relevant earlier quotes across scene shout, free conversation and courier. Originals remain saved. Applies to future requests.

Maximum recent user-led dialogue groups carried as originals, also limited by the character budget. A group includes its replies. Default: 12. Current input and confirmed facts are retained separately.
Select complete recent dialogue groups within this character budget. The current group is never silently cut. Earlier relevant quotes have a separate 6000-character budget. Default: 20000.

Automatically reduces older optional dialogue groups and rebuilds the cache toward this target. Required rules, facts and current input remain intact and continue even if they alone exceed the target. No local budget-error interruption. Default: 100000.

Target for estimated input tokens plus the configured output allowance. Automatically reduces optional history; required-only input continues above the target. This estimate is not the provider tokenizer or automatic model-capacity detection. Default: 128000.
